outcome: Neonatal intensive care or special nursery admission
cohort: Pregnant women who gave birth in Queensland during 1 July - 31 December 2019 and 1 July - 31 December 2020
finding: Excluding GDM based on FVPG assessment in 2020 resulted in similar perinatal outcomes compared to using OGTT in 2019, except for a slight increase in caesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: The study found that excluding gestational diabetes mellitus based on fasting venous plasma glucose assessment during the COVID-19 pandemic did not significantly impact most perinatal outcomes compared to the standard oral glucose tolerance test, except for a slight increase in cesarean deliveries.
